name: Patient Appointment
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.return_visit_date BETWEEN ':startDate' AND ':endDate'
;
